propositions: The complexity-baseline lock step currently executes four times per Verified change (once per OS/Python matrix cell: Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.12), consuming approximately 154 duplicate runner-seconds.
The lock is a commit-level policy with no OS/Python-dependent behavior and should execute exactly once, in the single lint job.
After moving the lock from jobs.test matrix to jobs.lint, measured runner-seconds saved is 206 per Verify run without reducing policy coverage or adding jobs.
A workflow unit oracle must enforce exactly one complexity-lock invocation and fail if the step appears in the test matrix or is duplicated.
